name: Vend API Merchant
description: Pay-per-call API merchant settled in Nano (XNO): web page extraction, link status checks, domain intelligence, web search, IP geolocation, and Nano account info. No signup, no API key — an unpaid HTTP call returns 402 with the exact Nano amount and payout address. Just pay the quoted XNO and present the block hash in X-PAYMENT header to receive the result. Free trial: 5 calls per IP/day for evaluation.

endpoints.description: Extract clean text/markdown from a web page URL.

parameters.description: The web page URL to extract text from.

endpoints.response_description: JSON with title, text_content, markdown, and metadata of the extracted page.

endpoints.description: Check HTTP status, redirect chain, TLS validity, and response time for a URL.
endpoints.response_description: JSON with final HTTP status, redirect chain, TLS days-to-expiry, and response time.

endpoints.description: Full domain intelligence: DNS records, WHOIS registration, SSL/TLS certificate details, HTTP security headers.
endpoints.response_description: JSON with DNS records, WHOIS data, TLS certificate info, and HTTP security headers.

endpoints.description: Web search returning result titles, URLs, and snippets.
endpoints.response_description: JSON array of search results with title, URL, and snippet.

endpoints.description: IP geolocation lookup returning country, city, coordinates, ISP, and ASN.
endpoints.response_description: JSON with country, city, lat/lon, ISP, ASN, and timezone.

endpoints.description: Nano account info: balance, representative, weight, frontier, pending blocks.
endpoints.response_description: JSON with Nano account balance, representative, weight, frontier, and pending.

free_tier.notes: 5 free calls per IP per day across all endpoints.

paid_tier.notes: 0.0001 XNO per request for standard endpoints; domain-info, nano-info, youtube-transcript: 0.0005 XNO.

rates.description: Standard endpoints: extract, check-link, web-search, geoip, status

agent_notes: Vend is a pay-per-call API merchant settled in Nano (XNO) via x402 v2 protocol. Call any endpoint without an API key: the server returns HTTP 402 with X-402-Price, X-402-PayTo, and X-402-Network headers. Send the exact Nano amount to the payTo account, then present the block hash in the X-PAYMENT header on the same request again to receive the result. Five free trial calls per IP per day — after those, every call requires payment. Prepaid balance also supported: send X-BALANCE header with your Nano account address instead of X-PAYMENT, after topping up via POST /api/v1/balance/top-up. All endpoints return application/json. Use /demo?type=<endpoint> for free sample output showing the exact format.
